signature_awards.description: Does the loader feel calm and steady for everyone, with no strobing, an invisible 5s seam, eased pacing, and a reduced-motion state that still says in progress?
signature_awards.why: One slow linear sweep with eased sway and out-of-phase opacity breaths, frame 5.0 verified equal to frame 0.0, no abrupt changes, and a reduced-motion held pour that still breathes so it reads as working on it.

signature_awards.description: Does the motion depict a real, specific moment of making coffee with material-true physics, so that swapping the coffee art for a generic shape would break the idea?
signature_awards.why: A pour, a hand-wobbled rim and a mug-ring stain taste of a real cafe, but the cream spiral rotates as a rigid decal - poured milk never spins as a finished shape, so the motion is a spinner wearing latte art.

signature_awards.description: Whether the loop's 5s-to-0s wrap is invisible in position, opacity and velocity, never fakes completion, and leaves every random frame a dignified place to cut away when the network decides the wait is over.
signature_awards.why: Linear 360deg sweep plus a zero-slope sway at the wrap means no position or velocity seam (verified in code and frames), no finish beat ever, and any frame is a clean pose of a pour in progress; reduced motion holds a composed pose that breathes.

signature_awards.description: How quickly a half-awake customer, seeing the 120px loader for the first time, understands it means the coffee is being made, judged by a one-second glance test.
signature_awards.why: A cup under a falling drop with a counting row of dots says something is being made in one glance.

signature_awards.description: Whether the animation runs only on transform/opacity and closes its 5s loop with no detectable seam, in lean markup.
signature_awards.why: Only transform/opacity on filled circles, 1s beats divide 5s, scar opacity 0 at wrap and heal is crema-on-crema so the reset is invisible; six shapes, lean.

criteria.name: Coffee concept & ownability
criteria.description: One clear idea drawn from the ritual of coffee (grind, bloom, pour, crema, tamp, drip) rather than generic steam-over-a-cup; it could belong to this one café-ordering brand and could anchor a wider motion language.

criteria.name: Motion, timing & perceived wait
criteria.description: Purposeful timing, rhythm and easing that make the wait feel shorter and calmer; the 5s cycle loops seamlessly and reads as steady, ongoing progress, never as stalled or as a finish that then resets.

criteria.name: Engineering craft & performance
criteria.description: Lean, self-contained build that honours every technical constraint: compositor-friendly animation (transform/opacity), crisp scaling from 120px to full splash, no jank on weak devices, readable and maintainable code.

criteria.name: Glanceability & inclusion
criteria.description: A half-awake customer understands 'your coffee is on its way' in one second at 120px; nothing flashes or demands attention; the prefers-reduced-motion version still clearly says 'working on it'.

criteria.name: Pitch
criteria.description: Short, persuasive, honest about trade-offs and risks; explains the idea, the timing choices, and why it would hold up across real wait times.
